seo.description: El Paso ISD starts Aug. 3, 2026, and ends June 3, 2027. See holidays, breaks, early-release dates, ADSY intersessions and the district calendar PDF.

hero.heading: El Paso ISD School Calendar 2026-2027
hero.mobileDescription: Classes begin August 3, 2026, and end June 3, 2027. Fall break is October 5-9. Students return January 6 after the holiday break and two additional no-school days; spring break is March 15-19.
hero.desktopDescription: El Paso ISD students start Monday, August 3, 2026, and finish Thursday, June 3, 2027. Fall break is October 5-9 and Thanksgiving break is November 23-27. The district calendar lists the holiday break as December 21-January 1; students also have no school January 4-5 and return January 6. Spring break is March 15-19. EPISD also uses ADSY intersessions for assigned students and staggers parent-conference early release by school level.

editorialSummary.heading: What El Paso ISD families should know for 2026-2027
highlights: August 3 first day and June 3 last day
175 instructional days for Elementary/Middle/PK-8, ACE and High Schools
Three ADSY intersessions, including a summer period after the regular school year
paragraphs: Fall ADSY intersession and districtwide fall break are separate on the EPISD calendar. The September 28-October 2 intersession is invitation-only for eligible students, with campuses notifying families who should attend. Districtwide fall break follows October 5-9, and students also have no school October 12 for teacher professional development. Regular classes resume October 13.

The district calendar lists the holiday break as December 21-January 1. Students also have no school January 4 for a teacher work day and January 5 for professional development, so the second semester begins Wednesday, January 6. In March, assigned ADSY students attend March 8-12 before the districtwide spring break March 15-19.

EPISD staggers parent-teacher conference early release by school level instead of dismissing every student early on the same date. The calendar also lists an EOC testing window November 30-December 11 and a STAAR/EOC testing window April 5-30. A summer ADSY intersession is listed for June 7-July 2 for students required to attend.

statistics.explanation: Dec 19, 2026–Jan 5, 2027, including weekends. The stretch contains 12 confirmed no-school weekdays.

statistics.label: Long weekends
statistics.explanation: Counts three- or four-day no-school stretches formed by a weekend plus one or two confirmed weekday closures. Longer school breaks are excluded.

statistics.label: Full-week breaks
statistics.explanation: Counts continuous no-school stretches containing at least five confirmed weekdays without regular classes. Adjacent holidays and weekends remain part of the same break.

comparativeInsights: The October 12 professional-development day extends the districtwide fall no-school period through Monday; regular classes resume October 13.
The December 21-January 1 holiday break and January 4-5 no-school days form an 18-day student break when weekends are included.
Early-release conference dates are staggered: high school, elementary and middle/PK-8 students each have two dates.
Students assigned to ADSY attend during intersession, while other students do not follow a regular instructional schedule on those dates.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school for El Paso ISD in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of classes is Monday, August 3, 2026. The first semester and first grading period begin that day.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for El Paso ISD in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last day of classes is Thursday, June 3, 2027. The calendar marks it as a full day and the end of the fourth grading period.

faqs.question: How many instructional days are on the EPISD calendar?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists 175 instructional days for Elementary/Middle/PK-8 schools, ACE Schools and High Schools.

faqs.question: When is El Paso ISD fall break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Districtwide fall break runs October 5-9. Students also have no school Monday, October 12, for teacher professional development, and regular classes resume Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: What does ADSY mean on the EPISD calendar?
faqs.answer: ADSY stands for Additional Days School Year. On the EPISD calendar, ADSY marks extended-year intersession days for students who are required to attend. Fall intersession participation is by invitation, with campuses notifying eligible families.

faqs.question: Who attends the EPISD fall intersession?
faqs.answer: Fall intersession runs September 28-October 2 and is invitation-only. Campus teachers notify eligible students who should attend; it is not a regular attendance week for every student.

faqs.question: Is EPISD intersession the same as fall or spring break?
faqs.answer: No. The fall ADSY intersession is September 28-October 2, while districtwide fall break is October 5-9. In spring, ADSY intersession is March 8-12 and districtwide spring break is March 15-19. Only students required to attend participate in ADSY.

faqs.question: Is there school in EPISD on Labor Day?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, September 7, 2026, is a Labor Day holiday with no school, and the district is closed.

faqs.question: Is there school in EPISD on October 12, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12, is a teacher professional-development day with no school for students. Regular classes resume Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Is there school in EPISD on Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no school Wednesday, November 11, 2026, for the Veterans Day holiday.

faqs.question: When is El Paso ISD Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is El Paso ISD winter break?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists the holiday break from December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Teacher work and professional-development days keep students out January 4-5, so classes resume January 6.

faqs.question: When do EPISD students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027, which is also the start of the second semester and third grading period.

faqs.question: Is there school in EPISD on January 4 or January 5, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. January 4 is a teacher work day and January 5 is a teacher professional-development day. The calendar marks no school for students on both dates.

faqs.question: Is there school in El Paso ISD on Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, February 15, 2027, is scheduled as a regular school day on the current EPISD calendar.

faqs.question: When is El Paso ISD spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Districtwide spring break runs March 15-19, 2027. Regular classes resume Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Who attends the EPISD spring intersession?
faqs.answer: Only students required to attend participate in the March 8-12 accelerated-instruction ADSY intersession. It takes place the week before districtwide spring break.

faqs.question: Does El Paso ISD have a summer ADSY intersession in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 2026-2027 academic calendar lists Summer Intersession - ADSY from June 7 through July 2, 2027. It is for students required to attend, not a regular school session for all students.

faqs.question: Are EPISD students off March 26 and March 29, 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. March 26 is the spring holiday, and March 29 is a teacher professional-development day with no school. The weekend connects them into a four-day break.

faqs.question: Is there school in El Paso ISD on Memorial Day?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, May 31, 2027, is a Memorial Day holiday. Students return June 1 for the final three class days.

faqs.question: What are the EPISD early-release dates for high school students?
faqs.answer: High school early release and parent-teacher conferences are scheduled September 9, 2026, and February 3, 2027. The standard high school early-release time is 12:35 p.m.; specialty-campus schedules differ.

faqs.question: What are the EPISD early-release dates for elementary students?
faqs.answer: Elementary students have early release and parent-teacher conferences September 15, 2026, and February 1, 2027. The listed early-release time is noon.

faqs.question: What are the EPISD early-release dates for middle and PK-8 students?
faqs.answer: Middle and PK-8 students have early release and parent-teacher conferences September 17, 2026, and February 9, 2027. The listed early-release time is 11:35 a.m.

faqs.question: What are the EPISD specialty-campus early-release times?
faqs.answer: EPISD lists early release at 12:25 p.m. for TMECHS Monday/Wednesday/Friday schedules, 12:05 p.m. for TMECHS Tuesday/Thursday schedules, 11:35 a.m. for ACE and 12:30 p.m. for Young Women's STEAM Academy. Families should confirm any campus-specific schedule changes with the school.

faqs.question: When are the EPISD grading periods?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods begin August 3, October 13, January 6 and March 22. They end September 25, December 18, March 5 and June 3.

faqs.question: When are the EPISD STAAR and EOC testing windows?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists an EOC window from November 30 through December 11 and a STAAR/EOC window from April 5 through April 30. Individual test dates depend on grade, course and campus, and state dates may change.

faqs.question: Has El Paso ISD posted a 2027-2028 academic calendar?
faqs.answer: El Paso ISD released a proposed draft 2027-2028 academic calendar on October 1, 2026. The district says it is pending Board approval and may change, so families should check the district Calendars page for the latest adopted version.

faqs.question: Where can families download the EPISD calendar PDF?
faqs.answer: The district's 2026-2027 calendar PDF is linked on this page and through El Paso ISD's Calendars page.
